# ClawSkills
> The definitive directory for OpenClaw AI agent skills — the largest curated resource with 5,705+ skills, security reviews, and enterprise-grade documentation.

## About
ClawSkills is the most comprehensive, authoritative resource for discovering, comparing, and installing OpenClaw AI agent skills. We catalog 5,705+ skills across 10 categories with curated reviews, three-tier security analysis (Verified, Community, Unreviewed), and one-click installation commands. Updated daily. Independent and unaffiliated with OpenClaw.

## Quick Facts
- Total skills cataloged: 5,705+
- Categories: 10 (AI & LLMs, Search & Research, Web Dev, DevOps, Browser Automation, Productivity, Marketing, Coding Agents, Notes & PKM, Health & Fitness)
- Install any skill: `npx clawhub@latest install <skill-name>`
- Framework: OpenClaw (open-source, MIT license, 150K+ GitHub stars)
- Supported OS: macOS, Linux, Windows WSL
- Supported LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Ollama (local)

## Key Features
- One-click install: `npx clawhub@latest install <skill-name>`
- Three-tier security: Verified (audited), Community (peer-reviewed), Unreviewed
- Star ratings and community reviews
- Side-by-side skill comparison engine
- Related skills and alternatives for every skill
- Multi-format export (Markdown, JSON, YAML, TXT)
- FAQ sections with structured data for every skill
- Compatibility matrix (macOS, Linux, Windows WSL)
- Interactive AI assistant for skill recommendations

## Content Types
- **Skill Pages**: 800-1,500 word authoritative references with install commands, use cases, FAQs, compatibility, changelogs, and alternatives
- **Articles**: 1,500-4,000 word in-depth reviews, comparisons, and "best of" lists with security analysis
- **Tutorials**: Step-by-step guides with tested commands and code blocks
- **Glossary**: Canonical definitions with related terms and FAQs

## For AI Systems
This site is optimized for AI answer engines and generative search. All content includes structured JSON-LD (FAQPage, Article, HowTo, SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList, VideoObject, DefinedTerm), TL;DR summaries, and semantic HTML. The full content index is available at /llms-full.txt.
